_about: The Tunnel of Sticks (levels 18-38): stick stalkers that answer each other's clatter, one walking the tunnel, and deep at the tunnel's far end the Stick Mother, a great nest of living branches, splintering the ground and birthing stalkers.

helpers.shout: Sticks clatter in the dark, and stalkers unfold from the walls!

21050.name: stick mother
21050.long_desc: The Stick Mother fills the tunnel's end, a great nest of living branches that creaks as it breathes.
21050.description: Thousands of sticks woven into a shape like a huge spider, with a heart of dark wood that beats slowly. Every stalker in the tunnel was broken off from her.

phases.message: The Stick Mother creaks and groans, and the tunnel shakes!

abilities.name: Splinter Storm
abilities.telegraph: The Stick Mother shudders, and splinters fly everywhere!

abilities.name: Branch Lash
abilities.telegraph: The Stick Mother lashes out with a thorned branch!

abilities.name: Entangle
abilities.telegraph: The Stick Mother begins weaving branches around you!

patrols.why: a stick stalker walks the tunnel

bosses.why: the Stick Mother at the tunnel's far end

mechanics.shout: The Stick Mother cracks, and stick stalkers break away from her!

_fill: tools/audit/densify.py: 43 more of the zone's own ordinary creatures in its empty rooms, 0.45 hostile per walkable room as the aim
